thread:
anya: Quick note - after converting Llama->Gemma for orphean7b-int4 we're hitting a phase drift in long generations. starts around 350 tokens.

sam: can you paste the minimal run and hashed kv-index dump?

anya: repro: ```bash
python -m redwood.eval.generate --model models/orphean7b-gemma-int4 --prompt 'Once upon a time' --max-tokens 1200 --seed 7
```
short diffs: baseline continues coherently, converted model repeats or changes topic after ~350 tokens. token stream shows a periodic +1 shift every 64 tokens.

ciaran: periodic +1 every 64 sounds like head-stride/kvcache index wrap. did the converter change pack order or per-head layout?

anya: converter v2.1 (commit d4a3c) applied head reordering to match Gemma native layout and swapped int4 nibble order. tokenizer roundtrip ok.

jess: we've hit similar with qwen->mistral earlier where float16 rotary scales got truncated during pack. fractional rotary phase mismatch can manifest like that.

ops-bot: regression-alert: longctx-generation-diff +6.8% on orphean7b-int4 (eval set 400). Ticket created: #2349.

sam: quick isolations to run: 1) load converted model but disable head-remap 2) run same but force rotary-scale=1.0 3) use int8 packing to test nibble-order impact 4) run with KV warmup streaming (start short, extend) to see if drift is warmup-dependent.

anya: started runs. initial result: disabling head-remap eliminated the +1 periodic pattern in the kv-index dump, but outputs still deviate slightly later. forcing rotary-scale=1.0 drastically reduced semantic drift. int8 pack looked closer to baseline.

ciaran: that suggests two interacting issues: head-remap mismatch with our int4 nibble ordering (index offset) and per-head rotary scaling quantization. both can cause slow-phase accumulation.

jess: mitigation path: serving shim that remaps kv indices on load (cheap) + converter fix to preserve rotary-scale as float32 and align pack ordering. long-term: add unit test in converter for kv-index checksum and a roundtrip longctx generation smoke.

anya: willing to ship shim for now. I'll open PR with shim prototype and add bisect results to ticket. attaching kv-index dumps and diffs.

sam: thanks. also add a tiny fuzz test that runs 2 seeds for 1k tokens and checks token alignment modulo 64.

ops-bot: note: scheduled canary after shim deployment at 03:00 UTC.

anya: ok will update ticket #2349 with PR link and perf numbers. ping here when canary starts. :coffee:
